+def _validate_prometheus_url(value: Optional[str]) -> Optional[str]:
+    if value is None:
+        return None
+
+    if not value.startswith("https://") and not value.startswith("http://"):
+        raise Exception("--prometheus-url must start with https:// or http://")
+
+    return value.removesuffix("/")
+
+
+def _validate_prometheus_other_headers(headers: Union[list[str], dict[str, str]]) -> dict[str, str]:
+    if isinstance(headers, dict):
+        return headers
+
+    return {key.strip().lower(): value.strip() for key, value in [header.split(":") for header in headers]}
+
+
+def _validate_namespaces(value: Union[list[str], Literal["*"]]) -> Union[list[str], Literal["*"]]:
+    if value == []:
+        return "*"
+
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        for item in value:
+            if item.startswith("*"):
+                raise ValueError("Namespace's values cannot start with an asterisk (*)")
+
+    return [item.lower() for item in value]
+

+    if value is None:
